title: bug: heartbeatStop PowerShell reload fixture omits Test-MoeWrapperReloadDeferred and fails the native Windows daemon suite
description: Native PS7 `cd packages/moe-daemon && npm test` on 2026-10-30: 5920 passed, one failure at src/util/heartbeatStop.test.ts:80. The extracted wrapper reload body calls Test-MoeWrapperReloadDeferred, but this test defines no such helper; child PowerShell exits 1 with command-not-found. Reproduce with npx vitest run src/util/heartbeatStop.test.ts on Windows with pwsh available; repair the fixture without weakening heartbeat ownership assertions.
definitionOfDone: The pending PowerShell heartbeat-job reload regression extracts/defines required real wrapper helper dependencies and passes on native Windows.
cd packages/moe-daemon && npm test passes on native Windows; retain bounded stop and unrelated-job protection assertions.
